description: Get authoritative consecutive streaks or non-consecutive week counts when any county area meets the selected drought category or worse. Supply states or one county, never both; omitted selectors mean supported nationwide counties. Counts are duration statistics, not program eligibility. Follow nextCursor with unchanged filters within five minutes.

county.description: County FIPS or exact/unique suffix-free county name, state; mutually exclusive with states.

limit.description: Default 25 rows per page; values above 200 are clamped with disclosure.

minWeeks.description: Minimum weeks, no more than requested inclusive map weeks.

mode.description: Window-bounded consecutive streaks or qualifying week counts.

states.description: Exact state postal, FIPS or full names; mutually exclusive with county.

name: drought_get_weeks_in_drought

anyOf.description: Canonical geography identity and known state or watershed attributes.

effectiveLimit.description: Effective page ceiling after clamping to 200.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_request_rejected`: USDM rejects a selector or date request. `ambiguous_area`: Several exact county names match. `unknown_area`: A county or state cannot resolve. `invalid_area`: Identifier or selector combination is invalid. `invalid_date_range`: Dates are impossible, reversed or shorter than minWeeks. `publication_unavailable`: No latest publication is available. `dataset_too_large`: Complete duration acquisition or cache exceeds resource quotas. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream durations are malformed or duplicate. `invalid_cursor`: Continuation is malformed, expired or filters changed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Coverage guidance for known legacy Connecticut counties.

limitNotice.description: Disclosure when the requested limit was clamped.

populationInterpretation.description: Present when the workflow includes a supported population metric.

rows.description: Complete authoritative rows on this page.

items.description: County drought duration reported by the official upstream source.

endDate.description: Observed consecutive streak Monday end within the effective window.

endMayContinue.description: Monday end touches the effective window boundary; later continuation is unknown.

startDate.description: Observed consecutive streak start within the effective window.

startMayExtendEarlier.description: Start touches the effective window boundary; earlier continuation is unknown.

thresholdRule.description: County qualifies if any area meets category or worse.

title: Get county weeks in drought
